name: DTR trip details
query: SELECT payload->'trip'->>'hotel' AS hotel,payload->'trip'->>'hotel_id' AS hotel_id,payload->'trip'->>'destination' AS destination,payload->'trip'->>'start' AS start,payload->'trip'->>'end' AS end,payload->'trip'->>'room' AS room,payload->'trip'->>'board' AS board,payload->'trip'->>'departure' AS departure,payload->'trip'->>'travelType' AS traveltype, (payload->'trip'->>'adults')::numeric AS adults,(payload->'trip'->>'children')::numeric AS children,(payload->'trip'->>'total')::numeric AS total FROM events WHERE event_type_id='e0ba0d5d-bc36-46a9-855e-dcb3697e5ca8' AND payload->>'demo_site'='dertour' AND payload->>'synthetic'='true' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1
